$comment: awesome-kit depends on plugins-kit:skills-kit for the plugin-ecosystem audit framework and skills_kit_lib. bootstrap_lib is REQUIRED: dispatch.py needs bootstrap_lib.codex for launcher resolution and the cmd-metacharacter refusal, and the orchestrate renderer parses routing rows with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration. llm_kit is the katsoft-llm-kit[config] package installed in awesome-kit's own venv from pyproject.toml (>=1.1,<2), not a shared-lib link, and it has no plugin edge: the renderer DEGRADES when llm_kit is not importable (rows list only the Claude core ids, disclosed in the render) and dispatch.py REFUSES (--model is resolved through its registry); only absence is probed, because the package pin guarantees the API. Auto-install skills-kit when missing. requires_bootstrap is 0.160.0, the first bootstrap that revokes undeclared bootstrap-written .pth links and stamps released-package targets in the venv check, which a venv holding a package-installed llm_kit relies on; the newest bootstrap CALLS this plugin makes are older (orchestration_guidance.py calls bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse_entries, first shipped in 0.150.0, and dispatch.py's bootstrap_lib.codex.build_codex_exec_argv 0.79.0).
